solution.brief:
The Aggregation Graph component allows to visualize the graph of the generated aggregation:
- the FG input allows to choose between full graph (including adjacent connections not directly defined)
or only the graph describing the rules sequence.
- the TOL input allows to override the default tolerance below which two elements are considered
connected
- when FG is set to True, setting FR to True filters "accidental" connections found against the given
aggregation rules.
- The CR input allows to specify a custom set of rules for filtering. If not specified, the component uses
the Aggregation rules.
- the F input allows to choose between flattened or tree-structured output
